# BH Drywall Metro Detroit

> Licensed & insured drywall contractor serving Metro Detroit, Michigan (Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb counties). Hang, tape, finish, repair, texture match, metal framing, ceilings, and water-damage rebuild. Mon–Sat.

## About

BH Drywall Metro Detroit is a Michigan drywall contractor serving Detroit and the surrounding tri-county metro. We provide written estimates, photo-based quotes, and scheduled crews for residential and commercial work.

- Business name: BH Drywall Metro Detroit
- Phone: (313) 236-4558
- Email: info@bhdrywallmetrodetroit.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat (see /hours)
- Service area: Metro Detroit, MI — Detroit, Dearborn, Warren, Sterling Heights, Troy, Livonia, Royal Oak, Farmington Hills, Clinton Township, and 90+ cities/neighborhoods.

## Services

- Same-day and scheduled drywall repair (holes, cracks, patches)
- Residential hang, tape, mud, Level 4 and Level 5 finish
- Basement and remodel drywall
- Commercial tenant improvement and retail buildouts
- Metal stud framing and soffits
- Suspended and gypsum ceilings; popcorn removal
- Water-damage flood cut, hang, finish, and texture match
- New-construction drywall packages
